transcript: Keep your life to yourself. Not everyone needs to know about your promotion. Not everyone needs to know about your vacation. Not everyone needs to know about your next step, your relationship, your healing, your plans. Some things grow better in silence. There is peace too sacred for the group chat. Share too much and the noise finds its way in. Opinions, projections, energy that is not yours. All of that enters when you open the door. You are not hiding. You are protecting yourself. Not every stage is meant to be displayed. The foundation of a building is never seen, but it is what holds everything up. In our monastery, there is a teaching we have repeated for generations. What you protect in silence grows stronger. What you expose too soon grows weak. Not because people wish you harm, but because every opinion carries weight, every outside doubt seeps in, every look that does not understand your process makes you question it, and a plan you question too soon is a plan you abandon. Work in silence. Let the results speak. The day you show what you built, no one will be able to destroy it because it will already be standing. Write in the comments in silence. If this reached you, but I want you to understand something, if it is hard for you to keep your life private, it is not because you seek attention. It is because you seek validation, and you seek it outside because you cannot find it within. The stress of living without peace leaves you insecure. When you have no calm inside, you need someone outside to tell you that you are doing well. You share so people will applaud you because the silence makes you uncomfortable. And silence only makes uncomfortable those who are not at peace with themselves. The day you build inner calm, you stop needing anyone to confirm anything for you. And if you want to build that kind of security that depends on no one, I have spent over 20 years learning in silence how to do it, and everything I know is inside the road back to calm. The link is in my profile.
